note: The player's van (Boss, 24 Oct 2026): one van at a time, part-exchanged when a new one is bought. Seven designs drawn from Boss's reference photos (art/reference/vans). length is the footprint in 64 px tiles along the heading (one tile wide), from the real length at 28 px per metre. drivable lists the ground art a van can use. verges (Boss, 28 Oct 2026, the black lines): on these maps the van keeps off the green car park verges and sticks to the road, going into a car park only by an entrance or a crossing laid over the verge. carParks (Boss, 28 Oct 2026): car parks a van longer than maxLength tiles can't go into, as it couldn't turn round to get out; the Factory Hauler stays on the road. bays (Boss, 28 Oct 2026): where a van of minLength tiles or more is parked on arriving at a map too tight for it to turn on, cab at x, y; it leaves straight out by the map's exit. starter is the van the opening chain sells and where it is parked when bought. name is the in-game name, from Boss's reference file names (the text after "Van N = "); motor-1 to motor-7 are only the model numbers (Boss, 28 Oct 2026: motors, not vans), and art names the model's van sheets (art/vehicles/sheets/map/map-van-N), which keep their names.
